title: Motionflare
lede: Motionflare reads a website from its URL and turns the real logo, colours, copy and screenshots into a branded launch video, with a live-action Film mode as the alternative.

points: Motion mode builds motion graphics from the site's own brand assets, up to 90 seconds, with music and optional narration.
Film mode generates a live-action style ad with people, voiceover and sound, between 5 and 45 seconds long.
The launch comment says it writes the story itself and uses no avatars or stock footage.
Edits happen in chat: describe what feels off and only that part is regenerated.
Exports at 1080p or 4K; the team says a finished video takes under 10 minutes.

sections.text: Founders who skip a launch video because keyframing one themselves takes days and an agency costs thousands, and marketing teams that need new videos every week.
The launch comment puts it at $29 a month, with the first video free to make and preview and no card required. Through December 1, Pro and Max are half price for the first month.
